title: Shut up, malevolent dragon! I don’t want to have any more children with you V1C98
paragraphs: Chapter 98: First, put on matching couple outfits.
The next morning, after Rosvitha finished preparing, she was ready to head to Sky City for their date.
Today, she wore a pure white long dress, her silver hair tied up with a headband, and a thin braid hanging down the side of her face.
It was the same style as the braid Leon had secretly woven for her while she was asleep, which had become a signature detail for Rosvitha, whether in her daily life or when traveling.
With a delicate egg-shaped face lightly powdered, enhancing her complexion, and subtle makeup complementing her queenly temperament, she exuded elegance and grace.
Leon, too, unusually wore a sporty suit, giving him a sunny and casual yet dignified appearance.
After all, they had to provide high-quality material for their daughter's composition, starting from their attire. Recalling the last time they wore suits was when they took a family portrait.
The couple left the house together, exchanging silent appraisals upon seeing each other, then nodding in unison.
"You finally look somewhat presentable," Rosvitha said with a teasing smile.
Leon rolled his eyes. "You don't have to compliment."
"Mom, Dad, are you ready?" Noia ran over from her sister's room with her backpack on her back.
"We're all set, ready to go anytime," Rosvitha replied.
Noia ran up to them, glanced at their outfits, then shook her head. "Nope."
The couple looked at each other in confusion.
What's wrong now? Rosvitha asked patiently, "What's not right?"
"Mom, Dad, you're going on a date, but you're dressed too formally and seriously right now. You look like you're going... on a blind date," Noia the director gave her evaluation.
The couple exchanged glances.
Oh, it does seem a bit too formal indeed.
They had only focused on "quality" and "seriousness," neglecting the most important aspect of a date: "relaxation and naturalness."
A date, fundamentally, is a game between partners, which is quite different from a blind date.
"Then I'll go change with Dad," Rosvitha said.
"No need, Mom. Anna and I went to the tribal clothing store this morning and picked out two suitable outfits for you directly. You can just change into them," Noia said.
The Silver Dragon Temple was just where Rosvitha lived and worked as a queen. The entire living area of the Silver Dragon Clan was quite large, with a complete industrial chain of life.

Naturally, clothes could be bought here. However, compared to Sky City, where everything in her tribe was already familiar, there was little novelty in arranging a date, and the effect would be greatly discounted.
Noia took off her backpack and pulled out two sets of clothes from it, handing one to Leon and one to Rosvitha.
The couple obediently followed Noia's arrangement.
Noia would provide her own suggestions and ideas based on the actual situation, and she even made some preparations in advance for this. This was a good thing, and the couple had to support it.
They each returned to their rooms.
Rosvitha opened the clothing bag and found a very youthful and energetic hoodie inside. The fabric felt smooth to the touch, and it should be very comfortable to wear.
The overall color of the hoodie was light gray, which matched her hair color well, and there was a cartoon bear pattern on the chest of the hoodie.
"It looks good, but..." Rosvitha couldn't help but mumble, "Am I going to look too childish in this?"
It wasn't that she was worried that this kind of youthful and girlish style would affect her image.
The Silver Dragon Queen never relied on appearance to make people submit; she relied on strength and personal charm.
Rosvitha just felt that she had never tried this style before... What if she couldn't handle it, and her daughter wasn't satisfied?
After some hesitation, Rosvitha took off her long dress and put on the hoodie. The hem of the hoodie just covered her buttocks, revealing a small amount of the hem of her undergarments.

She went to her wardrobe and paired it with a pair of pants and boots. These weren't her usual style of clothing, and the pants had not been worn for a long time. They felt a bit tight when she put them on.
Standing in front of the mirror, Rosvitha's cheeks flushed. "Well, it must be because the pants shrank, not because I gained weight."
Women were very sensitive to the numbers on the scale, even if they didn't look fat at all.
Yet, Rosvitha was still very strict with herself about managing her figure. However, despite the tightness of the pants, they did indeed accentuate her figure.

Rosvitha, tall and stunning, transformed from an elegant queen into a lively forest girl. She turned in front of the mirror again, confirming her outfit. "OK, ready to go. I wonder what Noia prepared for Leon."
Muttering to herself, Rosvitha opened the door and stepped out. As soon as she looked up, she saw Leon staring at her in shock.
Rosvitha was taken aback, about to ask "What's wrong," but her gaze fell on Leon's clothes, and she was just as astonished.
Their clothes... were exactly the same!
Except hers was gray, and Leon's was black.
"Couple outfits..."
Indeed, the eldest daughter's understanding of dating was completely beyond what these adults could imagine.
"Yes, couple outfits~ Because you two are the stars of today's date~ Of course, you should wear a couple outfits," Noia explained her reasoning.
Hmm, indeed, the stars should dress differently.
Meanwhile, Leon silently added another line to his "Memoirs of a Captive" — "Wearing couple outfits with a dragon."
Ahem, let us once again say the classic quote:
Leon Casmode's life was a glorious one, but also an abstract one.
"Mom looks so beautiful~ Dad looks so handsome~ Wow, you're wearing the same clothes!" Coincidentally, Muen ran over, followed by the head maid Anna.

Noia wore an expression of "I know everything" and explained to her sister, "These are couple outfits, representing that Mom and Dad are a loving couple~" She emphasized the "loving" part with stress and intonation.
The little dragon princess seemed to understand vaguely, but it didn't stop her from cheering, "Yay~"
Leon facepalmed, "Good daughter, don't explain too much. Let's get started."
"Okay, Mom and Dad, you go ahead. Anna will take me and Muen later," Noia earnestly organized everyone's tasks.
"Throughout today's date, you won't see us in your line of sight, so please be natural and relaxed. That way, we can achieve better results. Understand?"
Leon made a comical salute, and the dragon slayer stood at attention. "Yes, Director Noia!"
Ten minutes later, Rosvitha transformed into her dragon form and, along with Leon, headed to Sky City.
After waiting for a few more minutes, Anna set off with the two little dragon princesses. Her task today was to protect the two young princesses.
On the way to Sky City, there were no internal conflicts or wars within the Dragon Clan, so everyone smoothly reached Sky City without any obstacles.
Rosvitha transformed back into her human form —
To be honest, this was the first time she didn't want to transform back into her human form, because in her dragon form, others couldn't see that she and Leon were wearing couple outfits!
Leon's face was also burning red.

Despite being grown up, he had never worn couple outfits with any girl before — oh, forgot to mention, the premise of wearing couple outfits is having a partner, and Leon had been single for the first twenty-two years of his life.
The couple glanced at each other, then walked into Sky City together, beginning their first...
Date after marriage!
